prompts.gate:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: one isolated small Chinese gatehouse sprite for a hand-drawn oblique map.
Create a replacement gatehouse for the user's atlas, based on the three reference images just viewed (the handmade sequential castle drawing and its Chinese town adaptations). Capture their economical irregular ink shapes and flat faded colors. This is a tiny map symbol, not a detailed architectural illustration.
Subject: a squat ochre rammed-earth gate plinth with ONE simple dark arch passage; above it a small timber pavilion with ONE charcoal grey Chinese hip roof, muted brown posts. The gate has broad attachment cheeks on either side below parapet level for connecting city walls. No attached city walls.
Camera: high oblique orthographic bird's-eye view, from the south and slightly east, see front and RIGHT side and roof. World x axis across facade slopes DOWN toward the right at 8 degrees. All facade ground and parapet lines follow this SAME 8 degree slope. Depth lines go UP and RIGHT at 67 degrees. Vertical edges stay vertical. No perspective convergence. Do NOT draw a horizontal facade baseline.
Style: small handmade medieval map illustration, mildly wavering dark brown-black pen contour, 2 or 3 flat muted sand and charcoal color values, tiny sparse broken hatching only. Very simple geometric volumes. At intended display size 180 px wide, every feature should remain legible. About 12 loose roof strokes total, only 6 scattered masonry marks total on the entire plinth. Plain walls mostly empty flat ochre. No individually drawn tiles or brick grid. Roof silhouette gently curved with modest upturned corners.
Composition: ONLY this one gate, generous transparent margin all sides, no terrain slab, no road, no plants, no cast shadow outside the object, no text. Actual transparent background.
Avoid: photorealism, 3D render, realistic stone, paper grain, mottled texture, gradients, dense engraving, polished vector perfection, ornamental detail, foreground ground patch, surrounding town.
